QuestInfo.name: Cultivate a Christmas Tree!
QuestInfo.0: #p9000021# wants to see you grow a Christmas Tree. Go see #r#p9000021##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p9000021# gave you a Christmas Tree Journal. Now you just need a #bPotted Christmas Tree#k.
QuestInfo.2: #p9000021# gave you a Christmas Tree Journal. Now you just need a #bPotted Christmas Tree#k.

0.0: It's that time of year again! I'm trying to plant Christmas Trees all over Maple World, but boy, do I need a lot of trees! Mind growing some for me and keeping track of them in a Christmas Tree Journal?

no.0: You need a Christmas Tree Journal before I can give you a Potted Christmas Tree. How else are you going to record your tree-growing adventures?

yes.0: Click the Christmas Tree Journal in your ETC inventory to check out what rewards you've gotten and how many entries you've made. Every day you grow your Potted Christmas Tree into a #bMini Tree, you can make an entry in your Christmas Tree Journal#k.
yes.1: I'll get you set up with a Potted Christmas Tree. Talk to me by #bclicking the Event Notifier on the left side of your screen#k when you are ready!

default.0: Shouldn't you see if you have an Etc slot free?
